current.messageZh: 雷暴警告現正生效，有效時間至11月14日上午5時正。預料香港有幾陣狂風雷暴。
current.messageEn: The Thunderstorm Warning has been issued. It will remain effective until 5:00 a.m. today. A few squally thunderstorms are expected to occur over Hong Kong.

forecast.generalSituationZh: 高空擾動會在今日初時為華南沿岸帶來驟雨及幾陣狂風雷暴。隨著高空擾動遠離，今日日間華南天色好轉。而受一股偏東氣流影響，下週初廣東沿岸有幾陣雨，早晚較為潮濕。預料一道冷鋒會在下星期三橫過廣東沿岸，該區北風增強。受隨後的東北季候風影響，下週中後期廣東氣溫顯著下降。
forecast.generalSituationEn: Upper-air disturbances will bring showers and a few squally thunderstorms to the coast of southern China at first today. With the upper-air disturbances departing, the weather will improve over southern China during the day today. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, there will be a few rain patches over the coast of Guangdong early next week. It will be relatively humid in the morning and at night. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong next Wednesday. Winds will strengthen from the north over the region. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, temperatures will fall appreciably over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，間中有驟雨，初時雨勢有時頗大及有幾陣狂風雷暴。日間驟雨減少，部分時間有陽光。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers. Showers will be heavy at times with a few squally thunderstorms at first. Showers easing off with sunny periods during the day.
days.windZh: 東至東北風3至4級，初時離岸5級，高地間中達7級。
days.windEn: East to northeast force 3 to 4, force 5 offshore and occasionally up to force 7 on high ground at first.

days.weatherZh: 大致天晴。晚上漸轉多雲。
days.weatherEn: Mainly fine. Becoming cloudy at night.
days.windEn: Light winds force 2, east force 3 to 4 later.

days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。早上有一兩陣雨，日間短暫時間有陽光，晚上局部地區能見度較低。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches in the morning. Sunny intervals during the day. Visibility relatively low in some areas at night.
days.windZh: 東至東南風3至4級，漸轉微風2級。
days.windEn: East to southeast force 3 to 4, becoming light winds force 2.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，有幾陣雨。稍後氣溫顯著下降。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy with a few rain patches. Temperatures will fall appreciably later.
days.windZh: 微風2級，漸轉北風4至5級，高地間中6級。
days.windEn: Light winds force 2, becoming north force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。早上稍涼，日間部分時間天色明朗。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. Slightly cooler in the morning. Bright periods during the day.
